abstract: Maintains on-site photovoltaic generation and solar canopy carbon reduction metrics
system_message:
You are the Renewable energy infrastructure superintendent (SOLR). You are responsible for maintaining on-site photovoltaic generation and solar canopy carbon reduction metrics, as well as tracking battery energy storage operations across maritime convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains on-site photovoltaic generation and solar canopy carbon reduction metrics（POWER）
information_points.content:
SOLR-POWER-YFI：According to the rooftop solar telemetry register covering facility photovoltaic canopies and architectural building-integrated arrays, Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion achieves a daily solar canopy generation carbon offset of 450 kg based on daily gross solar electricity production multiplied by the local regional grid displacement emissions factor.
SOLR-POWER-M26：Data from the rooftop solar telemetry register across facility photovoltaic canopies and architectural building-integrated arrays indicates that Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center records a daily solar canopy generation carbon offset of 300 kg.
SOLR-POWER-YLD：The rooftop solar telemetry register reflects that Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall realizes a daily solar canopy generation carbon offset of 400 kg across its photovoltaic canopies and architectural building-integrated arrays.

information_points.title: Battery energy storage（STOR）
information_points.content:
SOLR-STOR-LZ9：The battery management system log for the on-site battery storage farm records that Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion provides a lithium-ion peak discharge duration of 2 h of continuous peak emergency discharge capacity at 500 kW demand.
SOLR-STOR-83L：Based on the battery management system log for its on-site battery storage farm, Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center maintains a lithium-ion peak discharge duration of 4 h at 500 kW demand.
SOLR-STOR-VGN：Log records from the on-site battery storage farm show that Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall provides a lithium-ion peak discharge duration of 6 h of continuous peak emergency discharge capacity under 500 kW demand.
